summary: First-finish smoke of OrçaNext. Backend endpoints (auth, company, clients, quotes, usage, duplicate, delete, status, public GET/approve/sign, PDF public+private, receipts FREE 402 + PRO ok, upgrade/downgrade mock, expiration flow, multi-tenant isolation, unauth 401, non-admin 403, other-company 404) all pass. 50/50 block returns 402 with blocked=true after seeding quote_usage. Frontend flows (landing, register→onboarding→dashboard, sidebar usage card '0/50', admin login → /admin with metrics/users) all working.
passed: GET / landing 200 with hero-cta-primary and pricing-pro-cta
GET /api/quotes/usage returns used/limit/blocked; increments on POST /api/quotes and duplicate
DELETE /api/quotes/{id} does NOT decrement usage (verified used=2 after delete)
Multi-tenant: user B GET /api/clients returns [] after user A creates client
POST /api/quotes/{id}/status ENVIADO -> public GET flips to VISUALIZADO
Expiration past date -> public status EXPIRADO; approve returns 400 'Este orçamento expirou.'
GET /api/quotes/{id}/pdf and public PDF both return application/pdf (%PDF header)
Receipts: FREE -> 402; after /api/plan/upgrade -> 200, downgrade back to FREE
50/50 block: seeded 47 quote_usage rows -> used=51, blocked=true, POST /api/quotes -> 402
Sidebar shows 'ORÇAMENTOS ESTE MÊS 0 /50' with 'Assinar Profissional' CTA
Admin login redirects to /admin with métricas + user list rendered
notes: POST /api/plan/upgrade & /api/plan/downgrade are MOCKED (no payment gateway) - verified they flip user.plan and change usage.limit to null / 50 respectively. Status update endpoint is POST /api/quotes/{id}/status (not PATCH).
